name: Northwind Billing
description: The billing settings surface for Northwind: concrete, operational copy on a calm neutral palette with one indigo accent. Every text pairing is authored to clear WCAG AA before the build proceeds.

surface.headline: Update your billing email
surface.subhead: Receipts and invoices are sent to this address. A change takes effect on the next billing run.

sections.heading: Current address
sections.body: Receipts currently go to finance@northwind.example. Update it below to redirect future invoices.

sections.heading: Confirmation
sections.body: We send a confirmation to both the old and new address so a mistyped entry is easy to catch.
